discovery: The draft runner proposed writing the SHA-256 of FILE_MANIFEST.sha256 into result_summary.json and then rebuilding the manifest. Because result_summary.json is itself covered by the manifest, this creates a circular and stale identity.
change: result_summary.json records only the stable manifest path. After every scientific, audit and environment file is finalized, FILE_MANIFEST.sha256 is built exactly once and its own SHA-256 is reported outside the covered files for registry and workflow use.
scientific_effect: None. Signals, paths, PnL, costs, gates and stage seals are unchanged.
reason: A reproducibility identity must be noncircular and recomputable from immutable covered files.
invalidated_output: No artifact identity produced by the circular draft procedure may be registered.
